scope: Visual correctness and fit of the supplied actual PNGs only; no learner-performance, P, memory, runtime or client acceptance claim.

imageReviews.style: Friendly abstract comic illustration: rounded soft forms, warm pale background, orange/blue chromosomes, dark rounded lettering; appropriate for the supplied Sek-I model scope.

actualDepiction.comparison: Two clearly separated alternative orientation/outcome rows A and B, with explicit ODER separator.

startEachAlternative.typeDistinction: One long pair and one short pair.
startEachAlternative.parentalOrigin: Orange maternal; blue paternal in the actual legend.
startEachAlternative.AOrientation: Both orange partners left and both blue partners right.
startEachAlternative.BOrientation: Long pair unchanged; short pair has blue left/orange right.

endpointsEachAlternative.chromosomeTypesPerCell: One long and one short, unreplicated/single-chromatid form.

fachlicheFindings: Correct homologous pairs and two chromosome types are present in each start cell.
Correct maternal/paternal combinations and counts are present in every endpoint.
Four outputs per alternative, with each of its two combinations duplicated.
The ODER separator and separate source cells clearly mark alternatives rather than eight products from one event.
No extra/missing chromosome type or irrelevant exchange mechanism found.
falseImplicationsExcluded: Not eight gametes produced by a single pictured meiosis
Not all four independent chromosome combinations required within one single depicted meiosis
Not a sex-specific claim of four functional egg cells

responsiveFindings.finding: Title, legend, alternatives, pair lengths, parental colors and all endpoint combinations clearly read/recognized.
Complete motif, ODER separation, origin labels, long/short types and four outputs per row remain clear; no relevant clipping.
Title, alternatives, ODER, chromosome types and output combinations remain clear. Origin legend is identifiable but very small; reading comfort is reduced.
responsiveFindings.limit: The delivered 360px PNG was inspected; no actual smartphone, browser or print layout was tested.

specificLimits: Length codes are a visual distinction, not a demand to measure chromosome sizes.
The diagram supplies only a simplified orientation/outcome comparison, not every meiosis phase.

imageReviews.style: Friendly abstract comic illustration: rounded soft forms, warm pale background, orange/blue chromosomes, dark rounded lettering; appropriate for the supplied Sek-I model scope.

actualDepiction.comparison: Two panels labelled Vorher/Nachher with two homologous X-shaped chromosomes per panel.
actualDepiction.sisterIndication: Upper brackets labelled Schwestern group the two chromatids belonging to each duplicated homolog.
actualDepiction.parentalOrigin: Orange maternal and blue paternal actual bottom legend.
actualDepiction.exchangeParticipants: The two inner non-sister chromatids of different homologs.
actualDepiction.exchangeRegion: Corresponding distal lower-arm regions below unchanged centromeres, marked at the same level; reciprocal orange/blue arrows.
actualDepiction.after: Outer maternal chromatid remains orange; maternal inner chromatid has blue distal region. Paternal inner chromatid has orange distal region; outer paternal chromatid remains blue.

fachlicheFindings: Correct corresponding reciprocal exchange between inner non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes.
Upper/centromeric regions and the depicted centromeres remain with their original chromatids.
Two reciprocal recombinant and two unchanged chromatids remain; no region or chromosome-count loss/addition found.
Schwestern remains a valid lineage/replicated-homolog term after recombination and does not imply unchanged identical genetic variants.
No arbitrary nonhomologous exchange, sister-only exchange, numerical aberration or molecular repair routine is drawn.
falseImplicationsExcluded: Not a complete gamete-output model: no gametes actually appear in the PNG
Not a chromosome-assortment assessment with a second chromosome pair
Not a proof that every real exchange creates new alleles or genes

responsiveFindings.finding: Before/after, sister brackets, reciprocal region markings/arrows, origin legend and two mixed inner chromatids are clear.
All model pieces and labels remain visible; corresponding region levels and opposite-origin distal segments are clear.
Central comparison, two exchange arrows and reciprocal distal colors remain clear. Sister/origin labels are identifiable but small; footer is identifiable only with concentrated reading.
responsiveFindings.limit: 360px is useful as a compact illustration; fine-label reading comfort is limited. No actual mobile/browser/book page was tested.

specificLimits: This is a correct supporting partial illustration of exchange, not the entire required supplied-model context.
No gametes, unaffected chromosome type2 or A/B variant symbols are actually drawn.
Fine labels and footer are compact at 360px; native/680 offer greater reading comfort.

ownExplanationBoundary: Correct shown models are illustrations/givens. Reading a color or caption is not learner evidence; the learner still needs to explain the causal link.
